Questions

Before you start

Is this therapy or financial advice?

Neither. It's a self-guided educational reset of breathwork audios and prompts. It isn't a replacement for medical or mental health care, or for financial advice.

I've never done breathwork. Is that OK?

Yes. Day 1 explains what to expect. Practise somewhere comfortable, never while driving or in water. If you're pregnant or have a medical condition, check with your doctor first.

How much time does it take?

About 20 minutes a day for five days. Go at your own pace, and keep access.

What if it's not for me?

[Your refund terms.]

If you want to go deeper, my Women & Wealth sessions are the next step, and you can apply for LIFE Mastermind.
